question:
The given bar graph shows the sales (in thousands) of four mobile brands for four years. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07d1434f523d9f0b678e960d79342b7b7ff12ee6465a713aa58e187297bc586b.png] 

If the sales of a brand is more than the average sales of these four brands in any year, then it gets a star. Which brand has the minimum number of stars from 2016 to 2020?
solution:
**FORMULA USED:**

Average = Sum of values/No. of values

**CALCULATION:**

Average of these four brands in the year 2016-2017

⇒ Average = ( 5 + 4 + 10 + 8) /4 = 6.75

Since, B3 = 10 and B4 = 8 has more values than the average 

Hence, According to the given Question, values more than average will get a star 

⇒ B3 and B4 get a star.

Average of these four brands in the year 2017-2018

⇒ Average = ( 7 + 9 + 11 + 10 ) /4 = 9.25

Since, B3 = 11 and B4 = 10 

Hence, B3 and B4 again gets a star

Average of these four brands in the year 2018-2019

⇒ Average = (12 + 11 + 10 +9)/4 = 42/4 = 10.5

Since, B1 = 12 and B2 = 11 

⇒ B1 and B2 gets a star

Average of these four brands in the year 2019-2020

⇒ Average = ( 14 + 15 + 12 + 15)/4 = 14

Since, B2 = 15 and B4 = 15

⇒ B2 and B4 gets a star

⇒ Total star gets by B1 = 1

⇒ Total star gets by B2 = 2

⇒ Total star gets by B3 = 2

⇒ Total star gets by B4 = 3

So, B1 gets a minimum number of stars

**Hence, B1 gets a minimum number of stars from 2016-2020.**
